name: Focus
summary:
Focus is a developer reference app designed to show developers how to build spatialized experiences using the Meta Spatial SDK.

This spatial brainstorming tool is designed to enhance your productivity and creativity. Experience a new way of working by building mind maps, prioritizing tasks, jotting down ideas and interacting with AI assistance.
